question: What earthly favor is denied to the Trailokyavijaya form with a bhadra spire?
premises: It is associated with a bhadra spire.
It is not beloved of the earth.
inference: The Trailokyavijaya form with a bhadra spire does not bring favor from the earth.
plain_english: The Trailokyavijaya, when it has a bhadra spire, is not beloved of the earth.
